purpose: runtime and variance pilot run BEFORE EXPERIMENT_PROTOCOL.md was frozen. It fixed sample sizes and confirmed the estimator reproduces P3/P4; it fixed no verdict and no gate threshold that depends on a P8 outcome.
observations_that_fixed_the_design: the per-path standard deviation of the Gamma_A integrand is ~7x larger for t3 than for gaussian at m=1 (SE 1.03 vs 0.14 at the same n), which is the finite-sample signature of the divergent third absolute moment declared in config.MOMENT_MARGINAL
4096 cycles cost ~0.16s (gaussian cusum) to ~0.42s (t3 cusum); 4,096,000 cycles per cell is therefore affordable and is adopted as the production size
max tau reaches ~5500 at the operating ARL, i.e. ~43 primitive blocks of length 128, so block overflow is routine and is exercised by every ordinary run
no exact simultaneous crossings (ties) were observed in the pilot
not_fixed_by_the_pilot: no gate threshold below was chosen after seeing a P8 production number

the window-law margin in CLOSURE_GATES.md G4 was chosen from the P3 CLOSED Gaussian boundary table (a cross-detector spread of 0.1%) and from the Stage-D Gamma_psi spread (a DIFFERENT estimand), not from any P8 measurement of Gamma_A across families
